title: Find the Locket
description: The locket is in the chest at the bridge crossing, latch still shut. The portrait inside is a younger man, dark-haired, no face Millbrook knows. Take it back to her anyway.

objectives.description: Take the locket back to the widow

notes: Turn (per REWRITE_SPEC): the portrait in the locket is not her husband. Left unresolved in the text - not explained, not flagged, not gated. No bible basis - local colour.
